common_rules.monthly_close: last observed session of each calendar month
common_rules.weekly_close: last observed session of each ISO week; observed calendar is not independently exchange-audited
common_rules.signal_timing: completed close; execute next observed session open
common_rules.decision_as_of: synthetic16:00America/New_York convertedUTC; not historical retrieval/early-close precision
common_rules.initialization: fresh cash and zero positions for each window; compute latent signals from all preceding allowed history and initialize first open from latest eligible scheduled decision; buy-hold enters first open
common_rules.warmup: pre-window history only; never scored as account performance
common_rules.missingness: reject missing/duplicate/nonpositive required prices and incomplete registered calendar; insufficient feature warmup means cash and explicit counter; no forward/backfill
common_rules.future_data_guard: discard all source rows after2025-12-31 before signals
common_rules.annualization: 252daily observations for volatility; account CAGR exponent1/number_complete_calendar_years
common_rules.volatility: sample std(ddof=1) of63 simple daily returns times sqrt252; equal-basket vol uses equally weighted daily return vector; zero/nonfinite risk estimate -> cash
common_rules.weight_convention: all policy formulas produce risky weights summing<=1; multiply result once by0.98; no allocation renormalization across inactive sleeves
common_rules.execution: solve N=V-c*sum(abs(w_i*N-a_i)); holdings=w_i*N/adjustedOpen; cash=N*(1-sum(w)); charge actual traded notional; no separate spread deduction beyond registered aggregate friction
common_rules.rebalance: monthly/weekly rules rebalance on every scheduled decision including unchanged targets; breakout rebalances whole target portfolio only when any latent sleeve flips, plus initial entry; buy-hold has no intermediate rebalances
common_rules.terminal: costed liquidation at final observed close; cash-onlyC01 no trades
common_rules.drawdown: max peak-to-trough over initial capital, open before orders, open after costs, closing marks, terminal close before/after liquidation; also report close-only drawdown; excludes intraday extremes
common_rules.distributions: embedded in adjusted-wealth prices; never add dividends again in fractional panel

formulas.sma_monthly: active iff current month-end close strictly greater than arithmetic mean of last10 month-end closes including current; fixed1/n slot per eligible symbol
formulas.breakout: latent state starts flat on earliest available history; require63 prior closes for entry; ifflat enter when C_day[t]>max(C_day[t-63:t]); iflong exit when C_day[t]<min(C_day[t-21:t]); currentclose excluded from thresholds; carry latent state through warmup; fixed1/n slots
formulas.relative_momentum: rank specified score descending; equal1/top_n weights; M04 gates each selected slot after rank, without replacement
formulas.volatility_cap: base basket equal1/n; scale all weights by min(1,0.10/sigma63); sigma is lagged known-at-decisionclose estimate, no full-sample normalization
formulas.low_volatility_selection: rank63-return individual sample vol ascending; bottom3 equalweights
formulas.reversal: rank C_day[t]/C_day[t-k]-1 ascending; bottom3 equalweights; R03 allcash unless its current completed-close SMA200 gate passes
formulas.linear_blend: calculate named monthly component formulas at same month-endclose; weighted sum of raw targetweights; one portfolio and one0.98multiplier, net orders beforefriction; not average equity curves
